deadline.value: The College of Engineering table lists the Computer Science PhD Fall intake as Closed; the Spring deadlines are August 15 (international) and November 15 (domestic).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The fetched pages do not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Applications received by the financial aid deadline are considered for assistantships and fellowships, with no guarantee stated.
funding.quote: received by the financial aid application deadline will be automatically considered for financial aid

entry_route.value: A baccalaureate degree from an accredited university is required; a master's can reduce coursework.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have earned a Baccalaureate degree from an accredited university

gre_general.value: The College of Engineering lists GRE scores as optional for the Computer Science PhD.

notes: The handbook PDF is older. The separate Computational Science PhD (College of Science) lists a priority deadline of December 1 for assistantship consideration: https://www.utep.edu/science/computational-science/about/admissions.html
